items.sefariaRef: Talmud Eser HaSefirot, Section XIII, List of Answers on Terminology 49:1
items.html: The essence of Arich Anpin is only two heads — the Galgalta and the Sealed Brain. But Mocha deAvira is the aspect of the lower seven of the Galgalta. Hence the Galgalta and Mocha deAvira are discerned together as ten Sefirot, which are thirteen, as above, Page 339, Item 96, for they include the illumination of the two heads together. And the Sealed Brain by itself also includes ten Sefirot and three additional Sefirot, like the Galgalta, which are the thirteen corrections of the Sealed Brain. (Page 372, Items 163-164).
